items.quote: the CAPEX for incremental HFC capacity equivalent up to 15,000 MTPA of R32 is progressing as planned and is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27
items.statement: Incremental HFC capacity of up to 15,000 MTPA of R32 to be commissioned in Q3FY27
items.speaker: Nitin Kulkarni

items.quote: the Chemours Project is progressing well and is on track for completion in Q1 FY27
items.speaker: Nitin Kulkarni

items.quote: the de-bottlenecking of MPP capacity at our Dahej facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27
items.statement: MPP debottlenecking at Dahej to be commissioned in Q3FY27
items.speaker: Nitin Kulkarni

items.quote: another scale-up order from a large European customer, is scheduled for Q4 FY26 deliveries
items.statement: Scale-up order from a large European customer to deliver in Q4FY26
items.speaker: Nitin Kulkarni

items.quote: And utilization for Nectar is again, as we had always said, this year, we would hit roughly 50% of the par.
items.statement: Nectar utilisation of roughly 50% of par in FY26
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: So it will be an annualized number that we are looking at 30% give or take plus/minus 200 basis points.
items.statement: Annualised EBITDA margin of about 30% (plus/minus 200 bps), expected to be hit or crossed in FY26
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: a safe bet is to look at what we are saying, 7%, 8% percent of revenue as our employee costs
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: we are inching closer to our aspirational number of 100 million
items.statement: CDMO revenue aspiration of USD 100 million
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: you will see that we will be in a position to fully utilize our capacity in the coming year itself
items.statement: Fully utilise the dedicated CDMO plant in FY27
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

tone.label: confident
